snippet.title: Beggar Simulator: Istanbul — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Beggar Simulator: Istanbul — a first-person comedy job sim.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5114920/
Out September 2, 2026 — 40% off during launch week.

Beggar Simulator: Istanbul is a first-person comedy job simulation.
Rent an act each morning, work the streets of Istanbul, read the person
in front of you, and back off before the municipal enforcement officers
arrive.

Every street wants a different lie. What works at a red light gets you
nothing in the Grand Bazaar.
